W2.arm: W2 within-chromosome, one genome per ST

decision_rule.abstract_must_change_if: W1 is materially smaller than the two-way estimate, defined in advance as a point estimate below half of 50.29
decision_rule.finding_is_reframed_if: N1 or N2 loses direction or its interval covers 1, in which case the result is a property of ST2/GC2 and the paper must say so in the title and abstract
decision_rule.interval_replaced_if: the cluster-bootstrap interval from C1 or C2 is wider than the analytic one, in which case the widest of the three becomes the reported interval
decision_rule.no_threshold_may_move: these criteria may not be changed after any arm runs
decision_rule.primary_becomes: if W1 is estimable, the within-chromosome odds ratio becomes the primary result for the title's claim and the two-way estimate is reported beside it as a different question, not as the headline
decision_rule.reported_regardless: every arm is reported whatever it shows, including any arm that is not estimable and why

W1_diagnostics.why: W1 reversed direction. Before reporting that, two checks registered BEFORE this arm existed were applied: the G2 weight ceiling from the original frozen design, and the intrinsic-OXA exclusion from NM-V4C-001.
W1_diagnostics.sparsity_note: a family in which BOTH hosts have zero class-A occurrences contributes zero to both Mantel-Haenszel sums and disappears without comment; those are counted here rather than left inside the family total
